A brick dragon — a towering winged beast on a hidden armature, jaws agape with trans-orange flame, every scale a slope or plate, the dominant focal terror.

An erupting volcano — a slope-brick cone cracking open with trans-orange lava flows and a cotton ash-plume billowing overhead, the molten focal catastrophe.

A collapsing tower — a brick tower built mid-topple, upper courses sheared and suspended on clear rods, dust bursting outward, the failing focal structure.
An emerging genie — a colossal trans-purple brick genie billowing up from a golden lamp in a coil of trans-smoke bricks, the magical focal giant.
A breaking beanstalk — a spiralling brick beanstalk punching through a cotton cloud-layer, leaves the size of rooftops, a tiny climber clinging, the soaring focal wonder.
A surging flood-wave — a SNOT-curled wall of trans-blue plate water with white-foam crest sweeping miniature buildings aside, the engulfing focal force.
A rising phoenix — a brick firebird ascending from a burning tower in trans-orange and trans-yellow flame-feather elements spread wide, the rebirth focal blaze.
A giant working mechanism — an enormous exposed brass-brick gear-and-lever contraption mid-motion, a tiny operator dwarfed among the turning cogs, the mechanical focal marvel.
A toppling statue — a colossal brick colossus mid-fall, cracking at the base on clear rods, stone-grey debris bursting outward, the crumbling focal monument.
A possessed funhouse — a warped brick carnival hall with bulging walls, leering printed-tile faces, and a spinning trans-red vortex at its heart, the unhinged focal horror.
A runaway train — a brick locomotive launched off a broken trestle mid-air on hidden rods, cars jackknifing violently behind it, the careening focal disaster.
A breaching sea-monster — a vast brick serpent arcing up from and back into a trans-blue sea around a tiny boat, the looping focal leviathan.
A rampaging giant creature — a colossal brick ape-beast mid-stride through a city block, fist raised, tiny brick cars crushed beneath its plate-built feet, the rampaging focal titan.
A crashing spaceship — a brick starship nose-diving on angled clear rods, hull plates shearing away, trans-orange engine fire trailing, the careening focal wreck.
